context: Suppress the primary-metric tile when the value is absent rather than printing N/A. Merge the Environment card into the receipt's environment block. Consolidate the three not-recorded counters into one, behind the existing 'Show missing metadata' disclosure. Suppress the empty Query Timings table for zero-timing results. Apply rx-ux-05's badge rule to the title pills.
description: On a zero-timing result the hero's primary-metric tile reads N/A - the most prominent number on the page is a non-value. A half-width 'Environment' card says 'Environment metadata was not recorded for this run' while the receipt beside it says 'No environment metadata recorded' (ResultDetail.tsx:281-318, RunReceipt.tsx:129-137). Three separate 'N fields not recorded' counters appear (15, 7, 2) alongside a 'Show missing metadata' link. The title row carries three pills including the invariant `passed`. A result with Query count 0 and Measurement samples 0 still renders an empty Query Timings table.
